{{Quote|This is Captain Vaclen Tor, in command of the Imperial frigate ''Steadfast'', Third Coruscant Imperial Fleet. I'm sorry, Admiral, but your command to surrender is incorrect and not in keeping with Imperial code.|Captain Vaclen Tor|<ref name="leg36" />}}
The '''''Steadfast''''' was an [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] in the service of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], [[137 ABY|seven years]] after the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Attack on Emperor Fel|overthrew]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] at the end of the [[Fel Empire]]'s [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. In 137 ABY, under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vaclen Tor]], the ''Steadfast'' was assigned to the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]], which had been tasked with protecting the strategically important [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. That year, the [[Core Fleet|fleet]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] launched a surprise [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]] on Ralltiir, intending to capture as many of the Third Fleet's [[Starship/Legends|ships]] as possible. Under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Peto Kelsan]], the Third Fleet engaged the Alliance forces until the [[Bastion Second Fleet]], aligned with [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]] Fel, arrived to bolster the Alliance fleet.

Facing overwhelming numbers, Kelsan surrendered the Third Fleet to Admiral [[Edouard Fenel]], the commander of the Bastion Second Fleet. However, Tor declared from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command center]] of the ''Steadfast'' that he must decline to follow Kelsan's orders to surrender, as it was their duty to ensure the enemy did not capture their ships. In response, Fenel ordered the crew of the ''Steadfast'' to rise up and replace Tor, and when that failed, Fenel ordered his entire fleet to open fire on the ''Steadfast''.

Refusing to help fire on the now heavily damaged frigate, Kelsan instructed the crews of the Third Fleet to disregard his previous order and to initiate the [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanisms]] on their ships, before using [[Escape pod/Legends|lifepods]] to evacuate to Ralltiir. When Fenel ordered his ships to fire on the lifepods of the Third Fleet, the commander of the Alliance fleet&mdash;[[Duros/Legends|Duros]] Admiral [[Gar Stazi]]&mdash;intervened, protecting the lifepods and escorting the ''Steadfast'', as the frigate's lifepod and self-destruct systems had been damaged. After the battle, under orders from Stazi, Tor and the ''Steadfast'' crew were deposited on the surface of Ralltiir, and the ''Steadfast'' was given to Fel as a gift.

==Description==
The ''Steadfast'' was an [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]],<ref name="leg36" /> a class of [[Starship/Legends|ship]] originally manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the [[Fel Empire]]. ''Ardent''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] were known to be one of the fastest [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The ''Steadfast'' was propelled through [[Realspace/Legends|space]] by three engine units and carried [[Escape pod/Legends|lifepods]]. The frigate was also outfitted with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]]. Internally, the ''Steadfast'' featured a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command center]] that was equipped with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] for communicating with other ships.<ref name="leg36" />

==History==
===Refusal to surrender===
{{Quote|I am sorry, Admiral, but your command to surrender is incorrect and not in keeping with Imperial code. Therefore, I must decline to obey.|Captain Vaclen Tor, from the bridge of the ''Steadfast''|<ref name="leg36" />}}
[[File:Steadfast_under_attack.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The ''Steadfast'' under attack from the Bastion Second Fleet]]
In [[137 ABY]], seven years after [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] [[Attack on Emperor Fel|deposed]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and established his [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith regime]] at the end of the Fel Empire's [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]],<ref name="leg1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> the ''Ardent''-class fast frigate ''Steadfast'' was assigned to Krayt's [[Coruscant Third Fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and served in the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Peto Kelsan]], the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] Third Fleet had been tasked with protecting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], a strategically important [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] and one of the great financial centers of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As neither Fel nor the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] were deemed to have sufficient [[Warship/Legends|warships]] to attempt an assault on Ralltiir, it seemed unlikely to the Imperials that the planet would be attacked.<ref name="leg36" />

However, in 137 ABY, the [[Core Fleet|fleet]] of the Galactic Alliance Remnant, led by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] admiral [[Gar Stazi]], launched a surprise [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]] on Ralltiir, intending to seize as many Imperial ships as possible. The Third Fleet engaged the Alliance fleet, with the ''Steadfast'' commanded by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vaclen Tor]] during the battle. The two fleets exchanged blows until the reason behind the Alliance's audacious attack became clear&mdash;an Imperial fleet loyal to [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]] Fel emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and joined Stazi's forces.<ref name="leg36" />

With the ''Steadfast'' and the Third Fleet now outnumbered and outgunned, Kelsan was contacted by his opponent from the Fel Empire, Admiral [[Edouard Fenel]], commander of the [[Bastion Second Fleet]]. Fenel issued an ultimatum for Kelsan's command to surrender within ten minutes or face total destruction, ordering Kelsan's crews to eliminate their commanding officers if they refused. Kelsan regretfully announced to his fleet that they were to comply with Fenel's orders; however, to the surprise of Kelsan, Fenel, and Stazi, Tor announced from the ''Steadfast'' that the orders to surrender were not in keeping with Imperial code, and he stated that he must decline to follow them.<ref name="leg36" />

===Imperial versus Imperial===
{{Quote|Admiral Kelsan, I gave an order for all Imperial ships to open fire on the ''Steadfast''. That includes ''your'' ships."''<br />''"We can't! The ''Steadfast'' is one of our own&hellip;!|Admiral Edouard Fenel and Admiral Peto Kelsan|<ref name="leg36" />}}
Speaking over a general frequency from the command center of the ''Steadfast'', Tor declared that they had to deny the enemy the chance to seize their ships, as it was both their duty and a matter of honor. Reminding Kelsan that they had sworn oaths to the throne now occupied by Krayt, Tor suggested that they activate their ships' self-destruct mechanisms and escape in lifepods. Enraged, Fenel ordered the crew of the ''Steadfast'' to rise up and replace Tor; however, the crew was loyal to Tor, and Fenel ordered his entire fleet to open fire on the ''Steadfast'' when they refused. After the ''Steadfast'' took heavy fire from the Bastion Second Fleet, Tor maneuvered the damaged frigate so that one of Ralltiir's [[Moon/Legends|moons]] was between him and Fenel's fleet. When Fenel ordered Kelsan to fire on the ''Steadfast'', Kelsan refused, instructing the crews of the Third Fleet to disregard his previous order to surrender. Kelsan went on to order the crews to initiate the self-destruct mechanisms on their ships before evacuating in lifepods and fleeing to Ralltiir.<ref name="leg36" />

[[File:Steadfast_after_Battle_of_Ralltiir.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The damaged ''Steadfast'', being protected by Rogue Squadron]]
In response, Fenel ordered his forces to open fire on the ''Steadfast'' and the Third Fleet's lifepods. However, Fenel was defied by Stazi, who positioned his fleet between the two Imperial fleets to protect the lifepods. The Duros admiral also ordered one of his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|units]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], to escort the ''Steadfast'' back to the Third Fleet. Now that it was safe to proceed, the crews of the Third Fleet evacuated their vessels, and Kelsan initiated the fleet's self-destruct sequence. The ships of the Third Fleet began to detonate, and Kelsan perished with his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger (Pellaeon-class)|''Avenger'']].<ref name="leg36" />

However, the ''Steadfast'' encountered a problem; it had suffered severe damage, leaving both its lifepods and its self-destruct mechanism offline. Taking advantage of the situation, Fenel sent his [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighters]] to destroy the ''Steadfast''. Unwilling to let that happen, Stazi brought his fleet around and had his ships spread suppression fire around the frigate. After being contacted by Emperor Fel, Stazi came to an agreement with the Imperial [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]]. Once they had deposited Tor and the ''Steadfast'' crew on Ralltiir, Stazi would send the ''Steadfast'' to Fel as a gift.<ref name="leg36" />

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|I authorize the crew of the ''Steadfast'' to rise up and replace Vaclen Tor and any of his staff who agree with him!"''<br />''"Won't work Fenel. This is ''my'' crew. They are loyal to the throne&mdash;''and'' to me. They will not take orders from ''renegades''.|Admiral Edouard Fenel and Captain Vaclen Tor|<ref name="leg36" />}}
As a ship in the Coruscant Third Fleet, the ''Steadfast'' was under the overall command of Admiral Peto Kelsan. The vessel itself fell under the authority of the Human Captain Vaclen Tor, who commanded the vessel during the battle above Ralltiir. Tor was regarded by Admiral Gar Stazi and others as a good man fighting for a bad cause. The ''Steadfast'' was crewed by [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] who were loyal to Tor and to the throne on Coruscant. After the battle, Tor and his crew were taken to the surface of Ralltiir under orders from Stazi, and the ''Steadfast'' was given to Emperor-in-exile Roan Fel as a gift.<ref name="leg36" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Steadfast'' appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 36|thirty-sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series,<ref name="leg36" /> published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 27]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/15-976/Star-Wars-Legacy-36---Renegade|text=Star Wars: Legacy #36 - Renegade}}</ref> The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Omar Francia]].<ref name="leg36" />
